citation: Meitzen, K.M., 2010, Geologic map of the Southwest Columbia quadrangle, Calhoun, Lexington, and Richland Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-50, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: OCR of a map sheet with columns interleaved; quotes taken from single column runs. Three cross sections (A-A', B-B', C-C') read from page image tiles: hole labels, and interval tops/bottoms and some land-surface elevations read off each section's feet scale (+/-3 ft, inferred). No horizontal scale printed on the sections, so no distances or contact points. Holes drawn off the profile (projected) get no land-surface elevation. Hole 32-141 on B-B' is drawn entirely above the profile and is left out there. Shelley 2007a reference garbled; skipped. Tertiary Undifferentiated thickness garbled in OCR; skipped. Map-face drill holes carry log numbers only; not recorded.
